description: Four countdown timers, each counting seconds from its own clock or steps from an external trigger, and each sending a trigger when it reaches zero

params.text: Sets that timer's starting value, 1 to 99; the display shows it, and changing it while the timer runs restarts the count from the new figure
Restarts that timer from its set value when the count reaches zero; with it off the timer stops at zero and will not start again until it is reset
Starts and stops that timer; once the count has reached zero with auto restart off, the button does nothing until the timer is reset
Takes one off that timer's count, but only while the timer is running
Returns that timer to the value its TIME knob is set to, and lets the start button work again after a count has run out

inputs.text: A trigger here takes one off that timer's count; with a cable in this jack the timer counts triggers instead of seconds
A trigger here resets that timer, as the reset button does
A trigger here starts and stops that timer, as the start button does

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V trigger each time that timer's count reaches zero

notes: With nothing patched into a timer's advance input it counts its own seconds; patching a cable there switches it to counting triggers, which makes the section a clock divider.
The light beside each display flashes whenever something takes one off that timer, whether the internal second or an external trigger.
